said.q: Dr. Reuther notes that this work with the lyrical evening atmosphere and two steamers belongs to a rich series of watercolors that Nolde painted in the spring of 1946 during a stay with his wife Ada, several months before her death, in the health resort town St. Peter on the North Sea coast. Both the expression and handling reflect the influence of J.M.W.
